passage.label: Al-Baqarah — establish prayer and give zakah; whatever good you send ahead you will find with Allah; Jews and Christians claim exclusive Paradise entry; challenge to produce proof; whoever submits face to Allah as muhsin has reward with no fear or grief; mutual rejection between Jews and Christians despite both reciting Scripture; Allah judges between them on Day of Resurrection; preventing masajid from Allah's dhikr is greatest injustice; disgrace in dunya and great punishment in akhirah; east and west belong to Allah; wherever you turn there is Allah's face; Allah wasiAA aleem

arabicExcerpts.text: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنۡ خَيۡرٖ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرٞ
وَقَالُواْ لَن يَدۡخُلَ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوۡ نَصَٰرَىٰۗ تِلۡكَ أَمَانِيُّهُمۡۗ قُلۡ هَاتُواْ بُرۡهَٰنَكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
بَلَىٰۚ مَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ وَجۡهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٞ فَلَهُۥٓ أَجۡرُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ وَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ

وَقَالَتِ ٱلۡيَهُودُ لَيۡسَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَقَالَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ لَيۡسَتِ ٱلۡيَهُودُ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ وَهُمۡ يَتۡلُونَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَۗ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ مِثۡلَ قَوۡلِهِمۡۚ فَٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ

وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن مَّنَعَ مَسَٰجِدَ ٱللَّهِ أَن يُذۡكَرَ فِيهَا ٱسۡمُهُۥ وَسَعَىٰ فِي خَرَابِهَآۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ مَا كَانَ لَهُمۡ أَن يَدۡخُلُوهَآ إِلَّا خَآئِفِينَۚ لَهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا خِزۡيٞ وَلَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٞ
وَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقُ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبُۚ فَأَيۡنَمَا تُوَلُّواْ فَثَمَّ وَجۡهُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٞ

mainSubject.label: Establish salah and give zakah; whatever good you send ahead for yourselves you will find with Allah; Allah baseer of what you do; Jews and Christians claim none enters Jannah except their own group; these are their wishes; challenged to bring burhan if truthful; rather whoever submits face to Allah as muhsin has ajr with Rabb with no khawf or huzn; Jews say Christians have nothing and Christians say Jews have nothing while both recite the Kitab; those who do not know say similar; Allah yahkumu baynahum on yawm al-qiyamah concerning their ikhtilaf; none more unjust than one who prevents masajid Allah from dhikr of His name and strives for their ruin; they should only enter in fear; khizy in dunya and great athaab in akhirah; to Allah belongs mashriq and maghrib; wherever you turn thamma wajh Allah; Allah wasiAA aleem
